news.title: Should You Pay A Growth Price For Tesla's Thin Profits?
news.summary: Tesla (TSLA) trades at about $357, and most of the argument around it is about what the company will build next. A plainer number gets less attention, and it is how much of each sales dollar the company keeps. Its operating margin over the past twelve months was 4.6%. That is the figure a holder should weigh before anything else.
